parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Express the LHS in terms of $\cos2\theta$ and $\sin2\theta$ - B1; e.g. $\frac1{\sin2\theta}-\frac{\cos2\theta}{\sin2\theta}$. Use the correct double-angle formula to express the LHS in terms of $\cos\theta$ and $\sin\theta$ - M1; e.g. $\frac{1-(1-2\sin^2\theta)}{2\sin\theta\cos\theta}$. Obtain $\tan\theta$ from correct working - A1 AG. Alternative method 1: express the LHS in terms of $\sin2\theta$ and $\tan2\theta$ - B1. Use the correct double-angle formula to express the LHS in terms of $\cos\theta$ and $\sin\theta$ - M1; e.g. $\frac1{2\sin\theta\cos\theta}-\frac{(1-\sin^2\theta)/\cos^2\theta}{2\sin\theta/\cos\theta}=\frac{4\sin^2\theta}{4\sin\theta\cos\theta}$. Obtain $\tan\theta$ from correct working - A1 AG. Alternative method 2: express the LHS in terms of $\sin2\theta$ and $\tan2\theta$ - B1. Use a correct $t$ substitution or rearrangement of $\sin2\theta$ in terms of $\sec^2 2\theta$ and $\tan\theta$ to express the LHS in terms of $\tan\theta$ - M1; guidance: $\left(\frac{\sec^2\theta}{2\tan\theta}-\frac{1-\tan^2\theta}{2\tan\theta}\right)=\frac{1+\tan^2\theta}{2\tan\theta}-\frac{1-\tan^2\theta}{2\tan\theta}$. Obtain $\tan\theta$ from correct working - A1 AG. Total: 3.

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: State an integral of the form $\pm\ln\cos\theta$ or $\pm\ln\sec\theta$ - *M1; OE, e.g. $[-\ln\cos\theta]_{\pi/4}^{\pi/3}$. Use the correct limits and insert exact trigonometric ratios - DM1; evidence of substitution required. Obtain a correct expression, e.g. $-\ln\frac12+\ln\frac1{\sqrt2}$ - A1. Obtain $\frac12\ln2$ from correct working - A1 AG; an intermediate step must be seen. Total: 4.
